checks.name: sparse-floor-measured
checks.detail: Da DO phan bo diem BM25 tren bo eval phase 2 truoc khi chon so (yeu cau cung cua phase): tai lieu DUNG: n=38 min 5.720 p25 20.857 median 29.331 max 100.486; cau LAC DE: n=69 min 1.984 median 6.187 p75 8.194 max 34.398. HAI PHAN BO CHONG LEN NHAU (off-topic max 34.398 > correct min 5.720) nen khong co san nao tach sach duoc. Da thu nghiem 3 gia tri tren cung bo 45 case: floor=None -> hit 100%, MRR 0.861, fp 4, abstain 42.86%; floor=8 -> hit 100%, MRR 0.861, fp 7, abstain 0%; floor=30 -> hit 100%, MRR 0.874, fp 5, abstain 28.57%. KET LUAN DO DUOC: giu sparse_score_floor=None — mot san chi mua duoc toi da +0.013 MRR va lan nao cung tra bang grounding. Day la lua chon CO SO DO dang sau, khong phai mot o trong chua dien.

notes: LOI NGHIEM TRONG TIM RA TRONG PHASE: upsert KHONG ghi sparse vector — ban sua goi _vectors_of khong ap dung duoc vi black da gop dong, nen code van dung {dense: ...} nhu cu. Hau qua neu lot: nhanh BM25 luon rong, hybrid ~ dense, va ket luan se la 'fusion khong giup gi'. Nghiem trong hon: test_upsert_stores_sparse_vector VAN XANH trong luc do vi no chi kiem 'search co tra ve point khong' — va point ve qua nhanh DENSE. Dung kieu xanh gia ma code-standards.md:84-87 canh bao. Da sua test thanh khang dinh THANG vao vector da luu (scroll with_vectors -> 'bm25' in stored.vector) cong mot truy van sparse thuan, va da KIEM CHUNG BANG DOT BIEN: pha lai upsert -> test do; khoi phuc -> xanh.

DANH DOI QUAN TRONG DA THANH TEST TUONG MINH: voi sparse_score_floor=None, chunk chi song sot neu prefetch dense DA QUA NGUONG bao lanh cho no. Nghia la BM25 XEP LAI duoc thu tu nhung KHONG BAO GIO them duoc tai lieu ma dense bo sot. Da tach thanh hai test cho ca hai nhanh (test_fusion_without_a_floor_cannot_add_what_dense_missed va test_fusion_with_a_measured_floor_admits_a_sparse_only_hit) thay vi giau danh doi nay di. So lieu that xac nhan danh doi la dung: recall khong mat gi (hit-rate dat 100%) vi dense prefetch lay toi 30 ung vien.

BL-013 DUOC XAC NHAN BANG SO: hit-rate chi tang 97.37% -> 100% (kich tran, chi con 1 case de tang), trong khi MRR tang 0.721 -> 0.861. MRR moi la cot noi len fusion co gia tri. Bang cua phase 10 phai lay MRR + false_positive lam cot chinh.

BL-014 DUOC XAC NHAN: cong cua phase 7 la 'giu false_positive <= 4' chu khong phai '= 0', vi dense-only da fp=4 tu baseline. Ket qua fp=4 sau fusion la DAT theo tieu chi dung; tieu chi goc trong phase file ('moi case null van tra NO_CONTEXT_ANSWER') chua bao gio dung ke ca o dense-only nen khong the la cong.

Han che da biet, ghi lai chu khong va: (1) tokenizer unigram tach am tiet tieng Viet nen 'máy học' thanh hai token roi — chap nhan, nua dense van giu ngu nghia, va them thu vien tach tu se danh mat chinh uu diem khong-dependency; (2) va cham crc32 ~1 lan tren 10^5 term — nhieu xep hang nhe, khong hong index; (3) prefetch sparse KHONG co nguong nen nhanh BM25 luon tra du limit ke ca khi khop rat yeu — RRF day chung xuong cuoi nhung chung VAN chiem cho trong top-30 di sang rerank; day la mot trong nhung thu phase 8 phai don.

Bat doi xung chuan hoa NFKC (ingest chuan hoa, cau hoi thi khong) da xu TRONG tokenize nen phuc vu ca hai chieu, khong phai sua orchestrator.py. Co test giu (test_tokenize_normalises_unicode) va test tu kiem tra rang hai dang NFC/NFD that su khac nhau.
adaptor/protocols.py van SACH ha tang: grep 'qdrant' -> rong. SparseVector la dataclass(slots=True) cua rieng tang adaptor; viec dich sang models.SparseVector nam tron trong vector_search.py.

tests/conftest.py KHONG phai sua — dung nhu phase du doan: khong co fake VectorStore nao, fixture dung chinh QdrantVectorStore that voi QdrantClient(':memory:'). Day la phan thuong cua quyet dinh o DEC-4.
